title: Tickets App
summary: Kiosks, desks and display boards kept in sync over native WebSockets.
description: A turn-management system for service desks, with normal and preferential tickets. A React 19 client and a Bun and TypeScript server share queue state in real time over native WebSockets. The backend runs in a Docker container.
challenges: Kiosks, desks and display boards had to show the same queue state at the same time, without each component managing its own socket.
Kiosks and display boards had to recover on their own when the network connection dropped.
solutions: The Bun server shares queue state with every client over native WebSockets (Bun.serve) and validates each incoming message with a Zod schema. A custom hook, useSocketTicket, wraps the socket, and a React Context exposes the queue state to every component.
Clients reconnect automatically with exponential backoff.
imageAlt: Three Tickets App screens: the waiting-room display board, the desk selection view and the ticket kiosk.
